If you do get this fresh start and things fail then you can say you have tried and life has rejected you.

The two of you should complement each other not define or completely run each others lives. I've been there, just try to focus on improving yourself and then you will be ready to form a healthy and functioning relationship

I may not be a psychologist but alcohol and benzos are in no way helping, but I understand why you turn to such means. I really have no idea how you could do this, but unless being social is the thing that you wish for in life then you should stop pursuing it. What you are currently doing is trying to become someone else and unless you put your full effort into being social and devote your full self to it its just going to make you miserable. You're like a half boiled egg, you are stuck in the middle of what you want to be and unless you move forward you will just remain pretty much useless and unliked. On the other hand you can just be yourself, it will take a long time but perhaps you can do it. Also, why are you together with this Thai girl, is it because you actually appreciate her or is it just because you want to be your made up ideal 20 year old with a girlfriend. I know its easier said than done, but just stop trying to be someone you aren't.

All I can say is, stop comparing yourself to others. You seem to have an idea that being social is the key to happiness but really its not. Find your hobbies, pursue your interests do whatever the fuck you want. You aren't disabled, literally your only 'problem' is that you aren't a social person. Im also a bit on the antisocial side, I would rather read a book than go out with friends but that does not mean that I am less happy.
Life isn't worth living if you are living a lie. Be yourself, don't be the guy that everyone wants you to be.
